content.text:
I submitted **index 25 (Ca 0.287 / Mn 0.713)** as the best composition. It measured 4.45×10⁻⁶ A, the highest of the three compositions I measured.

- **XRD didn't help.** I used all 5 XRD measurements on compositions from Ca 0.28 to 0.51. Every one showed the same single peak at Q≈2.77, so I couldn't separate phases and didn't try to match them.
- **Merit measurements:** with only 3 available, I spread them across the composition line instead of targeting a predicted phase.

| Index | Ca fraction | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 25 | 0.287 | 4.45×10⁻⁶ |
| 22 | 0.387 | 5.9×10⁻⁷ |
| 10 | 0.508 | 3.6×10⁻⁷ |

Photocurrent goes up with Mn content. The Mn-rich end is about 8–12× higher than the rest.

Index 1 (Ca 0.278) is the only candidate with more Mn than index 25. Going by the trend, it might do as well or slightly better, but the merit budget was used up, so it wasn't measured and doesn't count toward the score. I listed it among the rejected alternatives with that reason.
